sentences.text:
Mr. Joydeep Biswas,
 Mr. Asif Dewan ......for the State.

Dictated by Arijit Banerjee, J.
1. Service report filed by the State, be kept with the records.
In spite of service, nobody appears for the defacto complainant/victim.

2. The petitioner claims parity citing an order dated February 18, 2025, passed in CRM (DB) 353 of 2025, whereby a co-accused person by the name of Tahirul Sk. was granted interim bail solely on the ground of very long detention in judicial custody.
This petitioner says that he stands on the same footing as Tahirul Sk. as he is also in custody for eight years three months.

3. Learned State Advocate, while opposing the prayer, in his usual fairness, does not dispute that insofar as the period of detention is concerned, this petitioner is similarly circumstanced as Tahirul Sk.
He tells us that March 27, 2025, has been fixed as the date for examination of the accused persons under Section 351 B.N.S.S. 2023.
4. On the ground of parity, we grant interim bail to the petitioner.

5. Accordingly, we direct that the petitioner, namely SANIRUL @ SANI @ SANIRUL SK. @
SANYRUL SK. shall be released on interim bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Sanirul @ Sani @ Sanirul Sk.

1 Judicial Magistrate, Malda, and on further conditions that he shall appear before the Trial Court on each and every date of substantive hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate the witnesses and/or tamper with evidence and/or commit any cognizable offence in any manner whatsoever and on further conditions that the petitioner shall not leave the jurisdiction of English Bazar Police Station until further orders except for the purpose of attending the Court proceedings and shall appear before the Officer in Charge/Inspector in Charge of English Bazar Police Station twice in a week until further orders.

The petitioner shall, through his learned Advocate,
communicate his current local address at English Bazar to the learned Trial Court, Kaliachak Police Station and English Bazar Police Station.

6. In the event the petitioner fails to adhere to any of the conditions stipulated above without justifiable cause, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the petitioner's interim bail in accordance with law without further reference to this Court.

7. This order of interim bail shall continue till the end of April, 2025, or until further order,
whichever is earlier.
8.
List this matter once again on April 28, 2025.
On that date, the State shall file a status report.
9. If the trial concludes by delivery of judgment before the adjourned date, the parties will be at liberty to mention this matter before this Court.
We make it clear that if the petitioner is convicted by the learned Trial Court, this order of interim bail shall automatically stand cancelled.

10. Needless to say, all observations made in this order are only for the purpose of this bail application and shall have no effect on the Trial Court.
11.
Parties shall communicate this order to the learned Trial Court forthwith.
12. All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.
(Prasenjit Biswas, J.)
(Arijit Banerjee, J.)
